title: The final version of a recent approach towards quantum foundation
summary: In several articles, this author has advocated an alternative approach towards quantum foundation based upon a set of postulates, and based upon the notions of theoretical variables and of accessible theoretical variables. It is shown in this article that this basis can be considerably simplified. In particular, the assumption that there exists an inaccessible variable $φ$ such that all the accessible ones can be seen as functions of $φ$, can be dropped. This assumption has been difficult to motivate in the previous articles. From this, I get a simple basis for the main Theorems.The…
